name: Al Ramz Real Estate Company
summary: Al Ramz Real Estate Company engages in the real estate development business in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company is involved in the building construction, construction of roads and railway lines, benefit projects, demolition, site preparation, electrical installations, completion and finishing of buildings, and other specialized construction activities, as well as plumbing, heating, and air conditioning works.
